{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galactic Languages Working Group''' was a divison of the [[Historical Council|New Republic Historical Council]]. It compiled the historical catalog ''[[Writing in Basic: An Orthographic Chrestomathy]]'', which contained details of all the systems of writing that had been used to represent the language [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]].
